title: Group the anagrams
statement:
Two words are anagrams when one is a rearrangement of the letters of the other ("listen" and "silent"). Group the given words so that each group holds words that are all anagrams of each other, and words of different groups are not.

Input: the first line holds n (1 <= n <= 10000). Each of the next n lines holds one word of 1 to 20 lowercase letters. The same word can appear several times; every occurrence is kept.

Output: first a line with the number of groups g. Then g lines, one per group: the words of the group sorted in ascending (lexicographic) order and separated by single spaces. Order the groups by their first word, ascending.

Example
Input:
6
listen
go
silent
og
enlist
cat
Output:
3
cat
enlist listen silent
go og
